name: Most Valuable Wrestler

bestowals.source: New ERA of Wrestling's own Most Valuable Wrestler announcement for Season 1 (its own scoring system averaging each wrestler's three highest roleplay scores), naming The First the winner after a close three-way race.
New ERA of Wrestling's own Most Valuable Wrestler announcement for Season 2, naming Mr. Entertainment the winner by a 0.34-point margin over the runner-up.

epitaph: New ERA of Wrestling's own season-long honor, averaging each wrestler's three best roleplay scores and doubling as a way to bank a future title shot; the held record's two decided seasons went to The First and Mr. Entertainment.
